title: [SV+] Harvester Capacity & Reclaim
description: Overcommit and N-1 headroom per host, host utilisation, stopped VMs and the storage they hold, Longhorn thin-provisioning efficiency and volumes/PVCs nobody uses. Harvester 1.8.x.

panels.title: Cluster capacity (hosts = every node except the witness)
vCPU : physical core
panels.description: vCPUs provisioned to running VMs divided by the allocatable CPU cores of the hosts. Harvester overcommits CPU by default (the add-on's overcommit setting), so 3:1 is normal.

targets.expr: sum(count by (namespace, name) (group by (namespace, name, id) (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_seconds_total))) / sum((kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"}) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"})

panels.title: Memory allocated
panels.description: Memory allocated to running VMs / allocatable memory of the hosts.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(max by (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vmi_memory_domain_bytes)) / sum((kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"}) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"})

panels.title: Memory requested
panels.description: Sum of pod memory requests on the hosts / allocatable memory: what the scheduler sees.

targets.expr: 100 * sum((sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"})) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"}) / sum((kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"}) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"})

panels.title: N-1 memory headroom
panels.description: Memory requests / (allocatable - the largest host). Above 100% the cluster cannot reschedule everything if that host fails.

targets.expr: 100 * sum((sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"})) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"}) / (sum((kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"}) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"}) - max((kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"}) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"}))

panels.title: Stopped VMs
panels.description: VMs that are not running.

targets.expr: count(kubevirt_vm_info{status_group="non_running",namespace=~"$namespace"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Longhorn scheduled
panels.description: Storage scheduled (replicas included) / usable disk capacity of the Longhorn nodes. Longhorn refuses new volumes beyond its over-provisioning limit.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(longhorn_node_storage_scheduled_bytes) / sum(longhorn_node_storage_capacity_bytes - longhorn_node_storage_reservation_bytes)

panels.title: vCPUs provisioned vs allocatable cores
panels.description: Per host: vCPUs of the running VMs on it against the node's allocatable CPU.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (count by (namespace, name, node) (group by (namespace, name, node, id) (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_seconds_total)))
(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"}) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"}

panels.title: Memory allocated vs allocatable
panels.description: Per host: memory of the running VMs on it against the node's allocatable memory.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (max by (namespace, name, node) (kubevirt_vmi_memory_domain_bytes))
(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"}) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"}

panels.title: What-if: how many more VMs fit? (profile in the variables above; scheduler and Longhorn limits)
Fit: memory (now)
panels.description: Whole VMs of the what-if profile that still fit by memory requests on the hosts today: (allocatable - requested) / (profile memory / memory overcommit + QEMU overhead). Set the overcommit variable to the Harvester overcommit-config memory setting.

targets.expr: clamp_min(floor((sum((kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"}) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"}) - sum((sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"})) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"})) / (($wi_mem / $wi_overcommit + $wi_overhead) * 1073741824)), 0)

panels.title: Fit: memory (N-1)
panels.description: Same, if the largest host were lost: (allocatable - largest host - requested) / request per VM. 0 means the cluster already could not absorb a host failure.

targets.expr: clamp_min(floor((sum((kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"}) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"}) - max((kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"}) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"}) - sum((sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"})) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"})) / (($wi_mem / $wi_overcommit + $wi_overhead) * 1073741824)), 0)

panels.title: Fit: CPU (now)
panels.description: CPU is limited by what VMs really use, not by requests (Harvester overcommits CPU). (sizing target % x host cores - host CPU p95 over the window) / (profile vCPUs x observed average CPU use per vCPU of today's VMs).

targets.expr: clamp_min(floor((($target / 100) * sum((kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"}) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"}) - quantile_over_time(0.95, (sum(sum by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[5m])) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info) unless on (nodename) label_replace(kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"}, "nodename", "$1", "node", "(.*)")))[$window:5m])) / ($wi_vcpu * clamp_min(sum(rate(kubevirt_vmi_cpu_usage_seconds_total[5m])) / sum(count by (namespace, name) (group by (namespace, name, id) (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_seconds_total))), 0.01))), 0)

panels.title: Fit: CPU (N-1)
panels.description: As above with the largest host removed from the capacity.

targets.expr: clamp_min(floor((($target / 100) * (sum((kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"}) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"}) - max((kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"}) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"})) - quantile_over_time(0.95, (sum(sum by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[5m])) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info) unless on (nodename) label_replace(kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"}, "nodename", "$1", "node", "(.*)")))[$window:5m])) / ($wi_vcpu * clamp_min(sum(rate(kubevirt_vmi_cpu_usage_seconds_total[5m])) / sum(count by (namespace, name) (group by (namespace, name, id) (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_seconds_total))), 0.01))), 0)

panels.title: Fit: Longhorn sched.
panels.description: Volume replicas Longhorn will still schedule: (usable disk x over-provisioning % - already scheduled) / (disk size x replicas).

targets.expr: clamp_min(floor((sum(longhorn_node_storage_capacity_bytes - longhorn_node_storage_reservation_bytes) * $wi_overprov / 100 - sum(longhorn_node_storage_scheduled_bytes)) / ($wi_disk * 1073741824 * $wi_replicas)), 0)

panels.title: Fit: real disk space
panels.description: Same by actual free space, keeping the minimal-available reserve and assuming new disks fill to the expected fill % (thin provisioning).

targets.expr: clamp_min(floor((sum(longhorn_node_storage_capacity_bytes - longhorn_node_storage_reservation_bytes) * (1 - $wi_minfree / 100) - sum(longhorn_node_storage_usage_bytes)) / (($wi_disk * 1073741824 * $wi_replicas) * $wi_fill / 100)), 0)

panels.title: Still fit (limit)
panels.description: The smallest of memory (N-1), CPU (N-1), Longhorn scheduling and real disk space, and which resource is the limit.

targets.expr: bottomk(1, label_replace(clamp_min(floor((sum((kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"}) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"}) - max((kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"}) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"}) - sum((sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"})) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"})) / (($wi_mem / $wi_overcommit + $wi_overhead) * 1073741824)), 0), "limit", "memory (N-1)", "", "") or label_replace(clamp_min(floor((($target / 100) * (sum((kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"}) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"}) - max((kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"}) unless on (node) kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"})) - quantile_over_time(0.95, (sum(sum by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[5m])) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info) unless on (nodename) label_replace(kube_node_labels{label_node_role_harvesterhci_io_witness="true"}, "nodename", "$1", "node", "(.*)")))[$window:5m])) / ($wi_vcpu * clamp_min(sum(rate(kubevirt_vmi_cpu_usage_seconds_total[5m])) / sum(count by (namespace, name) (group by (namespace, name, id) (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_seconds_total))), 0.01))), 0), "limit", "CPU (N-1)", "", "") or label_replace(clamp_min(floor((sum(longhorn_node_storage_capacity_bytes - longhorn_node_storage_reservation_bytes) * $wi_overprov / 100 - sum(longhorn_node_storage_scheduled_bytes)) / ($wi_disk * 1073741824 * $wi_replicas)), 0), "limit", "Longhorn scheduling", "", "") or label_replace(clamp_min(floor((sum(longhorn_node_storage_capacity_bytes - longhorn_node_storage_reservation_bytes) * (1 - $wi_minfree / 100) - sum(longhorn_node_storage_usage_bytes)) / (($wi_disk * 1073741824 * $wi_replicas) * $wi_fill / 100)), 0), "limit", "disk space", "", ""))

panels.title: Disk full in (days)
panels.description: Linear forecast: days until Longhorn used space reaches usable capacity minus the minimal-available reserve at the growth rate of the look-back window. Blank when usage is not growing. Only as good as the window (at most the 5 days Prometheus keeps).

targets.expr: ((sum(longhorn_node_storage_capacity_bytes - longhorn_node_storage_reservation_bytes) * (1 - $wi_minfree / 100) - sum(longhorn_node_storage_usage_bytes)) / (deriv((sum(longhorn_node_storage_usage_bytes))[$window:1h]) > 0)) / 86400

panels.title: Host CPU utilisation
panels.description: % of CPU time not idle, per node.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m]))) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info)

panels.title: Host memory used
panels.description: 100 - MemAvailable %, per node.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - max by (instance) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes) / max by (instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info)

panels.title: Host utilisation over the look-back window
panels.description: Average and p95 of host CPU and memory use. A host that stays low at p95 has room to take VMs; one that is high at p95 has none.

targets.expr: max by (nodename) (avg_over_time((100 * (1 - avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m]))) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info))[$window:5m]))

max by (nodename) (quantile_over_time(0.95, (100 * (1 - avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m]))) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info))[$window:5m]))

max by (nodename) (avg_over_time((100 * (1 - max by (instance) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes) / max by (instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info))[$window:5m]))

max by (nodename) (quantile_over_time(0.95, (100 * (1 - max by (instance) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes) / max by (instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info))[$window:5m]))

panels.title: Stopped VMs and the storage they hold
Stopped: provisioned
panels.description: Provisioned size of the disks of VMs that are not running.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vm_disk_allocated_size_bytes) and on (namespace, name) kubevirt_vm_info{status_group="non_running",namespace=~"$namespace"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Stopped: actually used
panels.description: Longhorn actual (thin) size of those disks, one replica.

targets.expr: sum((sum by (namespace, name) (label_replace(label_replace(longhorn_volume_actual_size_bytes, "namespace", "$1", "pvc_namespace", "(.*)"), "persistentvolumeclaim", "$1", "pvc", "(.*)") * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left (name) (max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, name) (kubevirt_vm_disk_allocated_size_bytes) * 0 + 1))) and on (namespace, name) kubevirt_vm_info{status_group="non_running",namespace=~"$namespace"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Stopped > 30 days
panels.description: Stopped VMs whose last transition is more than 30 days ago.

targets.expr: count((max by (namespace, name) ((time() - kubevirt_vm_non_running_status_last_transition_timestamp_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace"}) / 86400 and on (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vm_non_running_status_last_transition_timestamp_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace"} > 0) and on (namespace, name) kubevirt_vm_info{status_group="non_running",namespace=~"$namespace"})) > 30) or vector(0)

panels.title: Stopped VMs
panels.description: Days since the VM stopped (blank when Harvester has no timestamp), disk size provisioned and actually used. Candidates to delete, archive or export.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, name) ((time() - kubevirt_vm_non_running_status_last_transition_timestamp_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace"}) / 86400 and on (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vm_non_running_status_last_transition_timestamp_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace"} > 0) and on (namespace, name) kubevirt_vm_info{status_group="non_running",namespace=~"$namespace"})
sum by (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vm_disk_allocated_size_bytes) and on (namespace, name) kubevirt_vm_info{status_group="non_running",namespace=~"$namespace"}

(sum by (namespace, name) (label_replace(label_replace(longhorn_volume_actual_size_bytes, "namespace", "$1", "pvc_namespace", "(.*)"), "persistentvolumeclaim", "$1", "pvc", "(.*)") * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left (name) (max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, name) (kubevirt_vm_disk_allocated_size_bytes) * 0 + 1))) and on (namespace, name) kubevirt_vm_info{status_group="non_running",namespace=~"$namespace"}

panels.title: Thin usage
panels.description: Longhorn volumes' actual size over their capacity.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(longhorn_volume_actual_size_bytes) / sum(longhorn_volume_capacity_bytes)

panels.title: Volumes detached
panels.description: Longhorn volumes not attached to a workload right now (includes the disks of stopped VMs).

targets.expr: count(longhorn_volume_state{state="detached"} == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Longhorn node storage
panels.description: Per node: disk usage, storage scheduled (replicas included) and capacity.

targets.expr: longhorn_node_storage_usage_bytes
longhorn_node_storage_scheduled_bytes
longhorn_node_storage_capacity_bytes

panels.title: PVCs used by neither a VM nor a pod (candidates)
panels.description: PVCs on Harvester storage classes, outside system namespaces, that no VM disk and no pod references. Review before deleting: a PVC can be bound for a purpose this dashboard cannot see.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_resource_requests_storage_bytes and on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{storageclass=~"harvester-.*",namespace=~"$namespace",namespace!~"cattle-.*|harvester-.*|kube-.*|longhorn-system"} unless on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) kubevirt_vm_disk_allocated_size_bytes unless on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info))

panels.title: Largest detached Longhorn volumes
panels.description: Detached volumes by actual size (disks of stopped VMs included): where the space sits while nothing uses it.

targets.expr: max by (pvc_namespace, pvc) (topk(15, longhorn_volume_actual_size_bytes and on (volume) (longhorn_volume_state{state="detached"} == 1)))
max by (pvc_namespace, pvc) (longhorn_volume_capacity_bytes and on (volume) (topk(15, longhorn_volume_actual_size_bytes and on (volume) (longhorn_volume_state{state="detached"} == 1))))

panels.title: Large, mostly empty guest filesystems
panels.description: Guest filesystems over 10 GiB that are under 20% used (guest agent): disks provisioned far larger than needed.

targets.expr: (100 * max by (namespace, name, mount_point) (kubevirt_vmi_filesystem_used_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace"}) / max by (namespace, name, mount_point) (kubevirt_vmi_filesystem_capacity_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace"})) and on (namespace, name, mount_point) (((100 * max by (namespace, name, mount_point) (kubevirt_vmi_filesystem_used_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace"}) / max by (namespace, name, mount_point) (kubevirt_vmi_filesystem_capacity_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace"})) < 20) and on (namespace, name, mount_point) (max by (namespace, name, mount_point) (kubevirt_vmi_filesystem_capacity_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace"}) > 10737418240))

(max by (namespace, name, mount_point) (kubevirt_vmi_filesystem_capacity_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace"})) and on (namespace, name, mount_point) (((100 * max by (namespace, name, mount_point) (kubevirt_vmi_filesystem_used_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace"}) / max by (namespace, name, mount_point) (kubevirt_vmi_filesystem_capacity_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace"})) < 20) and on (namespace, name, mount_point) (max by (namespace, name, mount_point) (kubevirt_vmi_filesystem_capacity_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace"}) > 10737418240))
